fix: Hoist the pane out of the LayoutBuilder closure, since nothing in it depends on constraints: before `LayoutBuilder::new(...)` add `let pane: Widget = Container::with_child(incular::widgets::internal::ScrollView::vertical(details_scroll.clone(), details_pane(kind, details_data))).alignment(Alignment::TOP_LEFT).color(background()).into();`, then inside the closure replace the `let pane = ...;` statement with nothing and pass `pane.clone()` to `SplitView::horizontal(tree, pane)`. Widget clone is an Rc bump (crates/incular-widgets/src/tree/widget/mod.rs:55), so the Details deep clone (title, subtitle, fields Vec, chips) and the widget rebuild happen once instead of on every constraint change.

Build the controls row once outside the LayoutBuilder closure: `let controls: Widget = Wrap::new(controls).spacing(4.).run_spacing(4.).into();` before the closure, then inside it use `Padding::new(EdgeInsets::symmetric(8., 0.), controls.clone())`. This removes the Vec<Widget> allocation that the closure makes on every constraint-driven rebuild.

State the invariant in the message, e.g. `shared.lock().expect("inspector lock is only held for short, non-panicking updates")`, or use the same non-panicking pattern as the neighbouring call sites (lines 238, 313, 527) if poisoning should be tolerated.
